column1: # Golden test: FY25 figures typed by hand from each company's annual report.

# ebitda = PBT - exceptional items + finance cost + depreciation - other income.
# debt = non-current + current borrowings; cash_like = cash + other bank balances + current investments;
# capex = purchase of PPE + purchase of intangibles (as a positive number).
# Balance-sheet fields are as at 31-Mar-2025. Fill 'expected' and 'source' (page number); leave blank to skip.
